input_artifacts.role: frozen v1 contract and error-envelope constraints

summary: Quick spec created for idempotent startup backfill in Supabase strict runtime to restore mentor center/matrix/radar coverage while preserving v1 contract and standardized error envelope.
decisions: Use startup sync as the single repair entrypoint; no new public endpoints.
Adopt idempotent insert-missing semantics by natural keys for runtime measurements/checkpoints.
Preserve frozen v1 contracts and standardized API error envelope without response-shape changes.
Include acceptance criteria that explicitly validate mentor routes: center, matrix, and radar.
risks: If natural-key uniqueness is not enforced at repository/table level, idempotence can be bypassed.
Startup backfill adds DB write work and may increase startup latency for large active-enrollment sets.
Sparse/invalid source enrollment-product-metric links can reduce effective backfill coverage if not handled defensively.
